question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Hardik Pandya hit four ________ fours and scored 72 runs in the match.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Consecutive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, the sentence wants to say that Hardik Pandya hit four **back-to-back** fours and scored 72 runs in the match.
 
• So, the appropriate word to fill in the blank should have a meaning similar to **'back-to-back or successive'**.
 
• **Consecutive** means ***following each other continuously or successive. ***(लगातार)
 
 
• **For Example** - This decline occurred after two **consecutive** years of increase.
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **consecutive**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Consecutive'.**

**The correct sentence is: **Hardik Pandya hit four **consecutive__** fours and scored 72 runs in the match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let's look at the meaning of the other words given:

 
• **Continuous** means uninterrupted flow. (निरंतर)
 
• **Ongoing** means continuing or still in progress. (चल रहे)
 
• **Constant** means a situation that does not change. (स्थिर)
